episode_summary: In this episode, Greg Roeder shares how he transformed his real estate business by focusing on building genuine relationships and creating targeted content for his dream clients. He emphasizes the importance of community engagement and strategic event hosting to generate referrals and maintain visibility. Greg also discusses the necessity of delegating tasks to prevent burnout and improve work-life balance.
